{{short description|British statistician}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}}
'''Dame Jilian Norma Matheson''' {{post-nominals|country=GBR|size=100%|DCB|FAcSS}} (born 27 March 1953)<ref>[https://uk1001.co.uk/director/12000920/DAME-JILIAN-NORMA-MATHESON Profile]{{Dead link|date=February 2026 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}, uk1001.co.uk. Accessed 9 October 2022.</ref> is the former [[National Statistician]] of the United Kingdom.

==Career==
Matheson joined the [[Office of Population Censuses and Surveys]] in 1975.<ref name=jil>{{cite web|url=http://www.statisticsauthority.gov.uk/national-statistician/about-the-national-statistician/jil-matheson/index.html |title=Jil Matheson |accessdate=2010-08-17 |publisher=[[UK Statistics Authority]] |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20100827190949/http://www.statisticsauthority.gov.uk/national-statistician/about-the-national-statistician/jil-matheson/index.html |archivedate=27 August 2010 }}</ref> She worked on the [[Expenditure and Food Survey]] and the [[General Household Survey]].<ref name=jil/> After 1998 she worked on [[Neighbourhood Statistics]].<ref name=jil/> At the ONS, between 2004 and 2008, she was the Director of Census, Demographic and Regional Statistics.<ref name=jil/>

She became Director General for Statistics Delivery at the ONS in 2008 with responsibility for the delivery of all ONS statistical operations and outputs, and for the development of the ONS’ statistical portfolio in consultation with users.{{citation needed|date=October 2022}}

She has been elected a [[Fellow of the Academy of Social Sciences]] (FAcSS) in 2001, a member of the [[Social Research Association]], and a [[Fellow of the Royal Statistical Society]] (FRSS).<ref name=jil/>

Matheson was awarded an [[Honorary Doctorate]] of Science by the [[University of Bath]] in December 2016.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Dame Jilian Matheson |url=https://www.bath.ac.uk/corporate-information/dame-jilian-matheson/ |access-date=2025-10-02 |website=www.bath.ac.uk}}</ref>

===National Statistician===
Matheson succeeded Dame [[Karen Dunnell]] as National Statistician on 1 September 2009, and Chief Executive of the [[UK Statistics Authority]] (and the [[Office for National Statistics]]).<ref name=jil/>
She retired from these roles on 30 June 2014. She was appointed [[Dame Commander of the Order of the Bath]] (DCB) in the [[2014 Birthday Honours]] for services to government statistics.<ref>{{London Gazette |issue=60895 |date=14 June 2014 |page=B3 |supp=y}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Queen's birthday honours list 2014: Knights|url=https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2014/jun/13/queens-birthday-honours-knights|work=[[The Guardian]]|date=13 June 2014}}</ref>
